Boundaries.Name: upload-frame-borrower
Boundaries.Contract: Retain copied attempts across source reads, ASKING, frame admission and cleanup. Never publish the enclosing upload's final error from a borrowed connection route.

Boundaries.Name: upload-discarded-completion
Boundaries.Contract: Consume an abandoned response once. An already-completed Redis error is internal with the source's copied retry count; the frame failure remains the upload owner's final error.
